body.message:
Hello,

I am interested in your apartment for a one-month rental starting from August 20th.

If the apartment suits me and remains available, I may extend my stay for several months, possibly up to 6 months.

For the first month, I would like to offer AED 11,500.

If this offer is acceptable, I am ready to move forward quickly and confirm the booking.

Please let me know if this would be possible.

Kind regards,
Bench
